Data.UnitTalk_KOR: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>가 오랜만에 푹 잤다고 한다. 오늘은 느낌이 좋다!
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> says she finally got a good night's sleep. Today's looking good!
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>はぐっすり眠れたようだ。今日はいいカンジだ！
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>说自己好久没睡得这么熟了，今天感觉不错！
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>說自己好久沒睡得這麼熟了，今天感覺不錯！

Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> เล่าว่าได้นอนหลับเต็มอิ่มในรอบนาน วันนี้รู้สึกดี!
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> berkata dia tidur nyenyak setelah sekian lama. Hari ini terasa menyenangkan!
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> nói rằng đã ngủ một giấc thật sâu sau một thời gian dài. Hôm nay cảm giác thật tuyệt!
